player:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite sheet PNG for a Python/Pygame side-scrolling pixel-art game.
Create ONE transparent-background animation sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal cells on a square canvas, preferably 1024x1024. No labels, grid lines, floor, shadows, checkerboard drawing, text or decoration outside sprites. True transparent alpha background.
Same character in all eight cells: a Brazilian IFRN Caicó teenage male student, warm medium-brown skin, rounded large black afro (black power), clearly readable dark rectangular glasses, green school polo with white collar and small geometric green/red/white school badge, dark navy trousers, small school backpack. One sneaker is green, the other sneaker is red, consistent across animation. Do not attempt tiny lettering.
Art direction: beautiful crisp 16-bit pixel art with dark outlines, restrained palette, blocky highlights, no blur or smooth vector appearance; compact platform-game proportions, distinctive round afro silhouette, full body visible, all poses facing RIGHT, 3/4 side view. Recognizable afro and glasses even when shrunk to 26x40 game pixels. Each sprite must use the same character scale and head size throughout. Each stands centered horizontally in its cell, feet on a common baseline at 88% cell height; sprites occupy about 76% of cell height, with fully transparent margin on every side. No clipping or overlap between cells.
Cell order left to right then top to bottom:
row 1 col 1: idle relaxed standing, eyes open.
row 1 col 2: idle subtle breathing, same position, tiny shoulder change.
row 1 col 3: walk contact pose, green sneaker forward, red sneaker back, arms counter-swing.
row 1 col 4: walk passing pose, green sneaker beneath torso, red sneaker raised moving forward.
row 2 col 1: walk opposite contact pose, red sneaker forward, green sneaker back.
row 2 col 2: walk opposite passing pose, red sneaker beneath torso, green sneaker raised.
row 2 col 3: airborne jump pose, knees bent, one arm raised, both shoes distinctly visible.
row 2 col 4: dash to right, torso leaning forward, arms tucked, legs extended behind, afro and glasses consistent, no detached particles.
This is a usable sprite atlas, NOT a concept-art presentation. Exactly eight complete consistent figures, one per equal cell.
player_correction:

Edit the attached transparent 8-frame student sprite sheet. Keep exactly the same character identity, brown skin, rounded black afro, glasses, green IFRN polo, backpack, pixel style, all eight existing poses and transparent background.
Required correction: in TOP ROW, THIRD figure (walking with sneaker extended toward the right), BOTH shoes are green by mistake. Recolor ONLY the sneaker at the BACK/LEFT of that figure from green to RED, matching the red sneakers of the other figures. Keep the front/right sneaker GREEN. Every figure must have exactly one green sneaker and one red sneaker.
Also maintain clean separable layout: exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Move each complete figure as needed so all of its pixels lie comfortably inside its own cell, with transparent gaps between neighboring figures. Especially the bottom-row jumping and dashing figures must not cross their cell borders. Preserve the SAME character scale for all figures and their original poses. No additional text, no grid, no background, true alpha transparency.
player_transparency: Use case: background-extraction. Remove the ENTIRE white/gray checkerboard background from the provided sprite atlas. Output a real PNG with transparent ALPHA CHANNEL (RGBA), NOT an RGB checkerboard simulation. Keep all eight student sprites completely unchanged, including white shirt collars, white sneaker soles and highlights inside each character. Keep brown skin, black afro, glasses, green polo and one red sneaker plus one green sneaker in every pose. Keep the exact current artwork, pixel style, layout, canvas and scale. Only remove the background; no redrawing, no text, no backdrop. The empty space between and around the eight figures must have alpha=0.
bugs:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production enemy animation sprite atlas for a pixel-art platform game.
Create exactly TWO frames of the SAME small yellow-green virus/bacteria monster, arranged side by side in equal cells on a wide 2:1 canvas. Genuine transparent background, no checkerboard, no ground, no text, no panel, no shadow outside the creature.
A squat asymmetric oval bacteria body, lime yellow-green main color, dark olive outline, two expressive mischievous eyes with dark pupils looking RIGHT, tiny jagged mouth, short virus-like surface spikes with rounded tips, a few darker green organelle spots, and four little short cilia feet. Cute hostile microbe, readable at only 26x24 game pixels. Polished crisp 16-bit pixel art, chunky flat pixel clusters, sparse highlights, no blur, no realistic texture.
Both frames show the SAME creature at the SAME scale and facing right. First frame neutral crawling pose, second frame slight squash/stretch with alternating cilia/feet and tilted surface spikes; eyes and pattern stay consistent. Center each complete creature inside its own half with at least 15% transparent margins on all sides. Align feet to the same baseline. Exactly two complete sprites.
